title: Learning Dashboard Panel
description: Build the PRISM Learning Dashboard panel for hyperMILL. Captures operator overrides (when programmer changes PRISM's recommended S/F), prompts for reasoning, and feeds into the Bayesian learning engine. Surfaces context-relevant tribal knowledge tips per material/operation. Shows historical performance data for the current material/machine/tool combination and Bayesian prior confidence for current recommendations.

forge_triple.hook: hm-plugin:override-capture-trigger — BUILT (fires when operator changes PRISM recommendation)
forge_triple.action: hypermill_plugin:capture_override — BUILT (records S/F override with operator reasoning)
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-learning-dashboard — BUILT (view learning history and confidence for current context)

sessions.title: Override Capture + Bayesian Learning
sessions.intent: Build the override capture system that detects when an operator changes PRISM's recommended parameters, prompts for reasoning, and feeds the delta into the Bayesian learning engine for posterior updates.

units.title: Override Detection + Reasoning Capture
units.description: Build override detection that compares applied parameters to PRISM's last recommendation. When delta exceeds threshold (>5% for speed, >10% for feed), trigger capture dialog asking 'What makes this better?' with pre-built reason categories (chatter, finish, tool life, experience, material batch variation) plus free-text. Store override record: {original, applied, delta_pct, reason, context(material, tool, machine, operation)}.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Override detection triggers when S/F delta exceeds 5%/10% threshold respectively
Capture dialog presents 6 pre-built reason categories plus free-text option
Override record stored with full context (material, tool, machine, operation, timestamp)

units.title: Bayesian Posterior Update Pipeline
units.description: Wire SelfLearningCAMEngine and BayesianOptimizationEngine to update priors from operator overrides. When an override is captured, update the Bayesian posterior for that material/tool/operation combination. Track confidence (0-1) per recommendation. After N overrides in the same context, PRISM's next recommendation incorporates learned adjustments. Implement Thompson sampling for exploration/exploitation balance.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Bayesian posterior updates after each override with measurable confidence increase
After 5+ overrides in same context, next recommendation shifts toward operator preference
Thompson sampling balances exploration (try physics-optimal) vs exploitation (use learned)

sessions.exit_gate: Override capture stores records + Bayesian posterior updates with confidence tracking | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: Dashboard Panel UI + Tribal Knowledge
sessions.intent: Build the Learning Dashboard HTML/JS panel with override history, tribal knowledge tips, historical performance charts, and Bayesian confidence indicators.

units.title: Learning Dashboard Panel HTML/JS UI
units.description: Build the Learning Dashboard panel with: override history timeline (last 20 overrides with reason badges), Bayesian confidence gauge (0-100% for current context), tribal knowledge tips section (filtered by current material + operation type from 3,700+ tip database), and historical performance chart (S/F over time for this material/tool combo with trend line).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Override timeline shows last 20 entries with color-coded reason badges
Confidence gauge displays 0-100% with tooltip explaining data points contributing
Tribal knowledge section shows top-5 relevant tips for current material/operation context

units.title: Historical Performance + Tip Ranking
units.description: Wire historical performance data from SessionEventLogEngine to show S/F trends per material/tool/machine combination over time. Build tip ranking algorithm that scores tribal knowledge tips by relevance to current context (material match, operation type match, machine family match). Add 'This tip helped' / 'Not relevant' feedback buttons to improve tip ranking over time.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Historical chart shows S/F trend with at least 10 data points for active combinations
Tip ranking prioritizes material-specific tips over generic ones (measurable via A/B test)
Tip feedback buttons update ranking scores and persist across sessions

sessions.exit_gate: Dashboard shows override history + confidence gauge + ranked tips + performance chart | omega_floor >= 0.90
